name: Fenix A320 family
measured: MSFS 2024, LKPR, Fenix A319, 2026-10-04: ground controls (#667): the main door by the default TOGGLE_AIRCRAFT_EXIT (exit 1) and the parking brake by the default PARKING_BRAKES both work (open and closed, released and set, read back); chocks and GPU only through the EFB API; with the chocks off the Fenix reads its parking brake released (BRAKE PARKING INDICATOR 0), set again with them on. Measured cold and dark; perhaps because the aircraft is off (no brake pressure, the chocks holding it), to recheck powered. 2026-10-03: each switch toggled while both the standard SimVars and the L:vars were traced. COM_STBY_RADIO_SET_HZ sets the RMP 1 standby (read back from L:N_PED_RMP1_STDBY: COM STANDBY FREQUENCY:1 stays as it was), and S_PED_RMP1_XFER puts it on active, which COM ACTIVE FREQUENCY:1 follows (2026-10-03, powered). The standard battery, avionics and external power do not follow the Fenix (battery and avionics read on while dark, the main bus reads battery 2's 28 V, external power 'not feeding' with EXT PWR ON); lights, parking brake, EXIT OPEN:0 and the transponder do and stay standard. L:var list from FSUIPC7's WASM 'List Lvars'.

extAvailable.note: measured: the AVAIL or the ON light

com1.note: measured: RMP 1 powered (1 with power on, 0 dark)

com1Standby.note: measured: RMP 1 in kHz; COM STANDBY FREQUENCY:1 does not follow the RMP

chocks.note: measured 2026-10-04: 1 in place, follows the EFB

gpu.note: measured 2026-10-04: 1 connected (EXT PWR available with it), follows the EFB

com1Swap.note: measured: the RMP transfer key; the stock COM1_RADIO_SWAP swaps the sim's own pair, which the RMP standby set never reached

chocks.note: measured 2026-10-04: through the EFB (GraphQL writeBool, as the Fenix EFB does); a write to L:B_CONFIG_CHOCKS does not stick

gpu.note: measured 2026-10-04: through the EFB; a write to L:B_CONFIG_GPU does not stick
